title: Two clarinets in the Elite band
summary: He explains how two clarinets played together, faking first and second parts.

blocks.x: How did that work out when you had two clarinets? How would you play? Would you read? Could you fake together? No, we'd fake together.
Fake together. I'm gonna have Charlie Love on trumpet. When he was sober. Yeah, when he was sober, he might not come there at all. That's when we had two clarinets.
Well, would one play lower register and one play upper, or would you both play upper and hominets?
Both of us would play up. Both of us would play down. We would play first and second though.
Mm-hmm. We could do that well.
A lot of numbers I didn't know how to play the second one. I'd play the lead.
We would have played the second. We had a nice band over there at the lights.
